analysis.capture_selection_policy: one cell per protocol/motion; prefer rpi_static_*_rtkfixed and dynamic *_final
analysis.position_sample_policy: independent_frame when available; all-event rate retained separately
analysis.rtk_interpretation: in-system comparison reference with alignment, timing, fix-state, and lever-arm limitations
analysis.rtk_pair_policy: RTK-fixed M1; one nearest independent UWB position per GPS solution

static_rtk_reference_consistency.interpretation: static absolute UWB-RTK errors are audit-only and invalid for cross-protocol ranking
